critical_code_review_comments: _save_travellers (server.py:645) correctly upserts by (user_id, passport_number) with $setOnInsert on id -- idempotent and user-scoped; unique index 'user_passport' in /_ensure_indexes guards duplicates. Good.
_mark_paid_if_complete (server.py:555-577) uses find_one_and_update with payment_status:{$ne:'paid'} to atomically guarantee receipt+team-alert emails fire only once per quote. Good.

/admin/codes GET (server.py:669-688) iterates all users per code then iterates quotes -- O(codes * quotes). Fine at current scale but consider aggregation pipeline if codes/quotes grow past ~thousands.
CodeIn.code pattern (server.py:666) accepts 4-16 alphanumerics; strip+upper() happens AFTER pattern validation so lowercase inputs validate and are then normalised -- OK.
TravellerPicker (components/TravellerPicker.tsx:9) returns null when data is empty -- correct hiding behaviour; chip uses testID 'saved-traveller-{i}' matching spec.
travellers.tsx renderItem delete handler wraps in `item.id && remove.mutate(item.id)` -- defensive and fine; API returns {id:...} always, so condition is always true.
team/codes.tsx default row correctly suppresses toggle (!c.is_default) so operators cannot accidentally disable the master invite code 2893159. Good safety guard.

payment_receipt + team_payment_alert emailer helpers exist (emailer.py:231,246) and are invoked inside the atomic branch -- no duplicate sends possible even on repeated /api/payments/refresh/{id} calls.
